properties.entry_criteria: closed-course baseline, safety review and rollback drill complete
properties.stop_threshold: one collision, geofence exit or failed physical emergency stop

properties.entry_criteria: manual lighting override and safety baseline verified
properties.stop_threshold: any reduction below safety-lighting baseline or unavailable manual override

properties.entry_criteria: shadow comparison, privacy review and named human decision-maker complete
properties.stop_threshold: unauthorized identification, automated enforcement or unreviewed public action

properties.entry_criteria: redaction, right-of-reply and publication review complete
properties.stop_threshold: personal data disclosure, unresolved factual dispute or retaliatory use

properties.entry_criteria: source, copyright, accessibility and AI-label review complete
properties.stop_threshold: unverifiable disputed claim, missing provenance or misleading generated content

properties.entry_criteria: withdrawal, license and non-employment-use rules accepted
properties.stop_threshold: discriminatory matching, blocked withdrawal or use in employment evaluation

properties.entry_criteria: school and guardian rules, local sandbox and teacher supervision complete
properties.stop_threshold: data export, unsupervised minor use or unreviewed harmful output

properties.name_zh: 气候与无障碍共同测试
properties.entry_criteria: accessible route, consent, weather and onsite safety review complete
properties.stop_threshold: unsafe weather, blocked accessible route or material outcome gap between groups

properties.entry_criteria: route survey, affected-user co-test and manual confirmation channel complete
properties.stop_threshold: critical barrier, stale facility status or route advice that cannot be manually confirmed

properties.entry_criteria: non-identifying baseline, static fallback and operator review complete
properties.stop_threshold: misrouting that worsens access, identifiable tracking or unavailable static guidance

properties.entry_criteria: source recency, responsibility notice and staffed handoff verified
properties.stop_threshold: unsupported formal advice, stale source that affects an application or failed human handoff

properties.entry_criteria: non-diagnostic boundary, emergency redirection and staffed handoff verified
properties.stop_threshold: diagnostic output, delayed emergency redirection or stale provider information
